{{Otheruses|Dreamer}}
The '''Dreamer''' and the '''Dreamt One''',<ref name ="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref> also referred to as the '''Dreamer''' and the '''Dreamt''', were the mysterious pair known as the ''Sheelal'' in the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Kaleesh (language)|native language]], whose fates were intertwined over eternity.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

After a strange [[Dream/Legends|dream]] was had by Kaleesh [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]] and the sudden appearance of [[Ronderu lij Kummar]],<ref name="Unknown Soldier">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> Qymaen was considered to be the living manifestation of the Dreamer, and Ronderu, the Dreamt.<ref name ="Lord of War" />
